SECTION ONE
Purpose, Scope, Basis, and Definitions
Purpose
ARTICLE 1 – (1) The purpose of this Regulation is to regulate the procedures and principles regarding
the objective, areas of activity, governing bodies, duties and the ways of work the governing bodies of Gebze
Technical University Women and Family Studies Application and Research Center.
Scope
ARTICLE 2 – (1) This Regulation covers the provisions regarding the objective, areas of activity,
governing bodies, duties and the ways of work the governing bodies of Gebze Technical University Women
and Family Studies Application and Research Center.
Basis
ARTICLE 3 – (1) This Regulation has been prepared based on subparagraph (2) of clause (d) of the
first paragraph of Article 7 and Article 14 of the Higher Education Law No. 2547 dated 4/11/1981.
Definitions
ARTICLE 4 – (1) In this Regulation, the following terms have the following definitions:
a) Advisory Board: Advisory Board of the Center
b) Center: Gebze Technical University Women and Family Studies Application and Research Center
c) Director: Director of the Center
d) Rector: Rector of Gebze Technical University
d) University: Gebze Technical University
e) Executive Board: Executive Board of the Center
SECTION TWO
Objective and Areas of Activity of the Center
Objective of the Center
ARTICLE 5 – (1) The objective of the center is to conduct scientific research and investigations in all
areas related to women's socio-economic status and problems, to ensure their implementation, and to engage
in training activities and studies to increase sensitivity, knowledge, and competence in all matters related to
women's studies and gender.
Areas of activity of the center
ARTICLE 6 – (1) The activity areas of the Center are as follows:
a) To conduct research, provide training , and organize seminars on gender and equality issues and
women's economic, cultural, social, political, health, and legal problems
b) To organize seminars, conferences, panels, symposiums , exhibitions, and similar scientific, artistic
and cultural events to raise public awareness about gender equality and women's issues
c) To publish periodicals covering topics related to women's studies, and to create a library and archive
in line with the objective of the center
d) To conduct research, organize training programs, develop , and implement support programs and
projects aimed at increasing women's employment and strengthening the position of women in social and
political fields and in urban life

SECTION 3
Governing Bodies and Duties of the Center
Governing bodies of the center
ARTICLE 7 – (1) The governing bodies of the Center are:
a) Director
b) Executive Board
c) Advisory Board
Director and Their Duties
ARTICLE 8 – (1) The Director is assigned by the Rector from among the university faculty members
for a period of two years. The Director whose term of office has expired may be re assigned. The Rector will
reassign the Director who leaves their post before the end of their term of office, using the same procedure.
The Director reports to the Rector for the regular execution and development of the Center's work.
(2) The Director submits to the Rector's approval a maximum of two people from among the University
faculty members to be assigned as deputy directors to assist them in their work. When the director is not on
duty, they leave one of the deputies as acting deputy. If the mandate lasts more than six months, a new Director
is assigned. When the director's term of office ends, the duties of their deputies automatically end.
(3) The duties of the Director are as follows:
a) To represent the Center, to ensure that the activities of the Center are carried out regularly
b) To summon the Executive Board and the Advisory Board to meetings, to determine the agenda of
these meetings and to preside over the meetings
c) To prepare the activity report of the center and the annual work program for the next year and to
submit it to the Rector as approved by the Executive Board
Executive Board and Its Duties
ARTICLE 9 – (1) The Executive Board consists of a total o f seven members, including the D irector
and six members assigned by the Rector for a two -year period from among the faculty m embers actively
working at the u niversity. If the membership becomes vacant for any reason, a new member is a ssigned to
complete the remaining term.
(2) The Executive Board meets at least twice a year and/or extraordinarily when necessary, with an
absolute majority upon the call of the Director, and decisions are taken by majority vote. In case of equality
of votes, the majority is deemed to be achieved in the direction of the vote cast by the Director.
(3) The duties of the Executive Board are as follows:
a) To determine the principles regarding the preparation of the activity report to be prepared by the
Director at the end of each working period, and to evaluate the presented report and the work program for the
next period
b) To make decisions on matters related to the operation and management of the center
Advisory Board and Its Duty

ARTICLE 10 – (1) Advisory Board consists of at least five and at most seven members who work on
gender issues related to the field of activity of the University and who are assigned by the Rector for a period
of two years from outside the University upon the recommendation of the Director, upon their request. A new
member is assigned to complete the remaining term if the duty becomes vacant for any reason.
(2) The Advisory Board meets at least once a year with an absolute majority upon the call of the Director
when deemed necessary by the Director.
(3) The duty of the Advisory Board is to express opinions and make recommendations on issues related
to the Center's field of activity.
SECTION FOUR
Miscellaneous and Final Provisions
Staff Need
ARTICLE 11 – (1) The academic, administrative, and technical staff needs of the Center are met by
the personnel assigned by the Rector in accordance with Article 13 of Law No. 2547.
Cases Without Provision
ARTICLE 12 – (1) In cases where there is no provision in this Regulation, the relevant legislation
provisions shall apply.
Enforcement
ARTICLE 13 – (1) This Regulation shall enter into force on the date it is released.
Execution
ARTICLE 14 – (1) The provisio ns of this Regulation shall be executed by the Rector of Gebze
Technical University.
